description: Retrieve the full metadata record for a specific LOC digital item. Returns the imprint (place, publisher, and date of publication), contributors, LCSH subject headings and the subject terms the search subject filter accepts, summary, languages, locations, rights information, physical description, call number, original and online formats, access restrictions, former catalog IDs, notes, and related items, plus the item's digital resources (each with its page count, representative image, PDF, and audio) and a window of its pages. Each page has a page_url and has_text; pass a page_url with has_text true to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page to read that page's text (newspaper, book, and manuscript pages alike). A long item lists 50 pages per call: continue with page_offset set to next_page_offset. Set include_files for each listed page's downloadable files (TIFF, JP2, JPEG sizes, text). Use after libofcongress_search_items on a result whose is_item is true. Pass the result id — a simple ID, an LCCN, or a slash-separated newspaper path — or a loc.gov item link (`https://www.loc.gov/item/<id>/`) or LCCN permalink (`https://lccn.loc.gov/<lccn>`), which is read as its id. Non-item results (is_item: false) — collections, exhibits, guides, newspaper pages, catalog.loc.gov records, hdl.loc.gov finding aids — have no item record and cannot be retrieved here.

include_files.description: Also list the download URLs of each listed page's files — every JPEG size, the JP2 and TIFF masters, OCR XML, and text files. Default false.

item_id.description: LOC item id from a libofcongress_search_items result's "id" field (where is_item is true): a simple ID ("2009632251", "2005691065") or a slash-separated path for newspaper issues ("sn95047246/1935-09-05/ed-1"). A loc.gov item link is also read as its id: "https://www.loc.gov/item/2009632251/", http or without "www.", or "item/2009632251"; so is an LCCN permalink, as its normalized LCCN: "https://lccn.loc.gov/2005567251", http or without a scheme; "lccn.loc.gov/2005-568294" reads as 2005568294. Any other URL, such as a /resource/ page URL, is rejected.

page_limit.description: Pages to list. Default 50. A response lists at most 100 pages: a larger page_limit (up to 1000) is served as 100.

page_offset.description: Index of the first page to list, 0-based across all of the item's resources. Default 0. Pass next_page_offset from the previous response to continue.

name: libofcongress_get_item

access_restricted.description: True when LOC restricts access to the original. Absent when upstream omits it.

call_number.description: LOC call number — the shelf location for requesting the physical original.

contributors.description: Contributors, creators, or photographers as LOC catalogs them, role included (e.g., "Washington, George, 1732-1799 (Author)"). One person can appear once per role. Empty when LOC lists none.

date.description: Publication or creation date as LOC catalogs it: free text, a year, or a full date (e.g., "1936 Apr.", "1909-1911.", "1894", "1912-04-16"). Absent when LOC records only a coded value ("uuuu", "||||") or none.

effectivePageLimit.description: The page_limit actually served when page_limit exceeded the per-call cap of 100. Absent when page_limit was within the cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_item_id`: item_id is not a LOC item ID, a loc.gov /item/ link, or an lccn.loc.gov permalink to an LCCN: a URL on another loc.gov or lccn.loc.gov path (such as a /resource/ page URL) or another host, an LCCN that does not normalize to up to three lowercase letters and 8 or 10 digits, or text with characters or segments no LOC ID has. `item_not_found`: No item exists for the given ID. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. `server_busy`: More Library of Congress requests are queued on this server than can start within this call's time budget. `request_timed_out`: The Library of Congress did not respond within the 50-second request budget. `upstream_unavailable`: The Library of Congress could not be reached, or answered with an error status, a bot challenge or other HTML page, or an unreadable response instead of its JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

former_ids.description: Superseded catalog identifiers or URLs this item was previously known by.

imprint.description: Imprint as LOC catalogs it: place, publisher, and date of publication (e.g., "New York : Werner School Book Company, c1900."), or a date alone on many photos and manuscripts ("1936 Apr."). Absent when LOC records none.

item_id.description: LOC item ID: the input item_id, or the id read from the loc.gov item link or LCCN permalink passed as item_id.

locations.description: Places the item depicts or originates from (e.g., "united states").

next_page_offset.description: page_offset for the next window of pages. Absent when this window reaches the last page.

notes.description: Descriptive notes and annotations from catalogers.

notice.description: Set when page_offset is past the last page, or when page_limit was capped. Absent otherwise.

online_formats.description: Formats the digitized surrogate is available in (e.g., "image").

original_formats.description: Material types of the original (e.g., "photo, print, drawing").

page_total.description: Pages across all of the item's resources.

pages.description: The window of the item's pages starting at page_offset, across every resource in order. Empty when the item has no pages or page_offset is past the last page.

files.description: Download URLs of the page's files: JPEG sizes, JP2 and TIFF masters, OCR XML, text. Present only when include_files is true.

items.description: Download URL; its extension names the format.

has_text.description: True when LOC lists an OCR or transcribed text file for this page. A blank page can have one: LOC's blank-page placeholder, which libofcongress_get_newspaper_page returns as empty text.

page_url.description: LOC page URL. Pass to libofcongress_get_newspaper_page to read its text when has_text is true.

physical_description.description: Physical or technical description of the original item.

related_items.description: IDs or URLs of related LOC records for follow-up retrieval; a title stands in for a related record LOC gives neither for.

resources.description: The item's digital resources, in LOC order. Empty when no digital surrogate exists.

items.description: One digital resource of the item, such as a photo, a volume, or a recording.

audio.description: Audio stream (MP3) of a sound recording. Absent when LOC gives none.

image.description: Representative image URL. Absent when LOC gives none.

pdf.description: PDF of the whole resource. Absent when LOC gives none.

url.description: LOC resource URL; its pages are this URL plus ?sp=N.

rights_information.description: Rights and reproduction statement for this item.

subject_headings.description: Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) assigned to this item, as cataloged (e.g., "United States--History--Civil War, 1861-1865"). Empty when the record carries none.

subject_terms.description: Subject terms LOC indexes this item under: lowercase heading components without dates (e.g., "civil war", "united states"). Each is a value the libofcongress_search_items subject filter accepts.

summary.description: Cataloger's abstract of the item's subject and historical context.

totalCount.description: Pages across all resources — mirrors output.page_total for agent reasoning.

title: Get LOC Item
